reasons: Claimed status is compliant and the cited text supports it: Section 20.1 provides an unqualified Vendor defence/indemnity for third-party IP infringement or misappropriation claims covering Customer, Affiliates and their personnel, satisfying the core of the preferred position.

Section 20.2 adds the remaining preferred triggers (Vendor's breach of Applicable Law, unauthorized access/disclosure of Customer Data caused by Vendor, gross negligence/wilful misconduct/fraud), 20.4 supplies standard notice/control/cooperation/settlement-consent procedure, and 20.5 gives procure/modify/replace/refund remedies.

Customer's reciprocal indemnity in 20.3 is appropriately narrow (unmodified Customer-supplied material used as authorized and Customer's own violation of law, with carve-outs for Vendor Technology, modification, combination or instructions), consistent with the playbook.

Section 21.3 places indemnification obligations in Excluded Claims, so Vendor's indemnity sits outside the liability cap — better than the fallback's 3x super-cap and favourable to us, so nothing to flag.
No redline or comment was proposed, which is correct for a compliant finding; the deterministic check confirms Vendor IP indemnity is present.
